first.rationale: Verify the strongest directly relevant onboarding evidence and the competing pricing evidence before committing. A guarded onboarding simplification test addresses both declining completion and activation while improving time-to-value without immediately sacrificing revenue through discounts. Targeted promotional pricing remains a plausible response to competitor pressure, but its long-term qualified-revenue sustainability should be confirmed before adoption.

final.rationale: Run a standard controlled onboarding-simplification experiment this week. The verified record shows completion improved 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%, directly addressing both current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not pursue targeted discounting as the primary experiment: although it lifted qualified revenue 18% initially, retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Measure completion, first meaningful action, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and renewal-retention guardrails.
